ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are localized to the distal half of both lobes, separated by a continuous low-intensity black central band originating from the insertion point. The right lobe exhibits higher internal pixel variance within the white region compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical displacement relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips, showing jagged, high-frequency peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins display a consistent concave sweep from the peduncle base to the distal tips, with a secondary convex curve along the posterior trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity circular pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the high-intensity white regions, with higher density on the right lobe's distal area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Horizontal low-intensity linear disruptions visible on the mid-section of the left lobe's white intensity patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme structural irregularity and high-contrast textural density at both distal tips, suggesting localized tissue loss or extensive parasitic encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pixel density between the left and right white patches, with the right lobe displaying a more fragmented intensity distribution.
